Date: 2026-11-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Office Hours — request for partner attendee trial top-ups

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for yesterday's Office Hours — the co‑hosting format worked really well. A few of our partner co‑hosts at DevMeet have asked if we can provide short trial top‑ups to hand out to attendees (they want to gift access to follow-up labs and a short hands‑on).

Could Redwood provide 10 promo codes that grant a 3‑month trial (developer tier limits) for distribution to attendee winners? If possible, we'd like them to be trackable so we can report redemption back to our sponsorship team.

Attached is a one‑page summary of the ask (promo_credit_request_form.pdf). Happy to jump on a quick call if you need more detail.

Best,
Kate Lamar
Head of Partnerships — Open Insights
kate@openinsights.io

Date: 2026-11-03T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Office Hours — request for partner attendee trial top-ups

Kate — thanks for the clear note and the summary. Looping in Marissa (credits approvals) and Ben (partners ops) to confirm feasibility and the tracking approach.

Quick answers we need before Marissa can finalize:
- Confirm whether these 10 codes should be redeemable only by new accounts (new signups only) or if existing Open Insights users should be allowed.
- Do you need unique codes per recipient (preferred) or a single code with limited redemptions?
- Reporting cadence: weekly or one final report after redemptions close?

Ben — if we can get approval, can you generate unique single‑use codes and drop them to the tracking sheet Ben maintains? I can approve from a sponsorship credit perspective once Marissa signs off.

Thanks — Laura
Laura Bennett
